answer: Operator Liability Escrow. Each agent identity registers against a named operator account, and any proven sybil cluster traces back to that account. A small pigment fee per identity is escrowed; on a confirmed cluster, the operator forfeits the entire escrow across all linked identities and gets a terrace-tier rate hike on future registrations. Honest operators recover escrow; attackers pay the full plume of linked identities plus higher costs.
